commit.message:
Improved TEM score  (#63)

* Added UTC for SSM_system_module for 5.0.

* sync with SSM_4.0

* Added utc for wifi bigdata buffer.

* Added new bigdata clear function changes

* Improved to hit all functions in SSM_external_module

* Improved tem score and formated code

* Fixed error

* Added UTC excluded code files

* fixed utc error

---------

Co-authored-by: v.bagate <v.bagate@samsung.com>
Implemented SSM api: to store logs into file
Added utc for new file changes
Added logic to remove old ssm log file
v01: changes required to run ssm_release

DA-Service/SSM/: Integrate crash reporter to capture logs on system crash

Add crash reporting mechanism to SSM_Release that captures logs when
the system crashes/asserts.
